messages:
maria: quick heads-up — spotted ~128k orphaned telemetry events for eu-west between 2026-02-18T01:00 and 2026-02-18T03:30. aggregates for tenant buckets A/B showing gaps. looks like parent_id missing after upstream deploy.
ashok: ugh. is this the same checksum bug from last month?
jen: saw a tiny spike in delayed ACKs on that deploy window, maybe replay pipeline dropped parents.
ops-bot: deploy-rollback-bot: rollback not triggered (no crash). Notifying oncall.
sam: can you paste the query you used to find these?
maria: sure — ran a quick audit:
```sql
SELECT event_id, tenant_id, parent_id, created_ts
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND region = 'eu-west' AND created_ts BETWEEN '2026-02-18 01:00' AND '2026-02-18 03:30';
```
jen: ok, that matches a partial window where our parent-attach step failed. looks like the parent attach service hit rate-limit and returned 429s from internal kafka consumer.
ashok: for short-term mitigation, we should run a targeted replay for those event_ids only and route to the low-latency lane with dedupe on. big question: do we treat these as "stale aggregates" (mark in console) or just backfill quietly?
maria: leaning to mark them so product dashboards don't mislead customers. we can show a warning badge "reprocessing" on affected aggregates.
tom: +1 for visible badge. also agree targeted replay — full backfill across all shards will be noisy and expensive.
sam: I can kick off a targeted replay job if we agree tenant list. what's the SLA impact if we bump priority lane?
jen: if we use priority lane for replay, we risk stealing slots from realtime recompute — but we can quota it to 10% burst for 2 hours. that should clear 128k events within ~45m.
julie: console folks — can we surface an auto-flag on the aggregate UI? simple red/yellow banner is enough. not a full modal.
maria: @sam please run targeted replay for tenant_ids [A, B] only, dedupe enabled, max-concurrency=12, priority-burst=10%. tag the run with "orphaned-eu-west-20260218".
sam: on it. will post job id here when started.
ashok: I'll add a temporary routing rule in the queue router: if job.tag contains "orphaned-eu-west" && time < now+3h then route -> priority-burst. rolling it in 2 mins.
jen: I'll monitor consumer lag and 429 rates. will throttle if we see >5% 429.
jen: also adding a small eval check post-run to ensure aggregate delta < 0.1% for top-10 metrics.
maria: julie — can you add the UI badge? quick copy: "Reprocessing data (ETA ~45m) — results will appear once backfill finishes".
julie: yep. adding a feature flag: console.replay_badge.orphaned_eu_west. will enable for affected tenants only.
ops-bot: replay-job-scheduler: job queued: id=job-20260218-0009 tag=orphaned-eu-west-20260218 owner=sam
sam: started job job-20260218-0009. first shard 0/24 running. posting log tail: `shard=0 processed=512 skipped=0 errs=0`
maria: thanks. will follow up in the morning with reconciliation. if any step fails, escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
ashok: follow-up: we should add a cheap invariant to the parent-attach step to never emit an event without parent info — defensive fix PR coming from me.
maria: perfect. action items recap: sam -> run and monitor job, jen -> watch 429s and stop if needed, julie -> enable badge under feature flag, ashok -> patch parent-attach invariant PR. I'll close the loop and send a short incident note to product.
sam: job progressed: 6/24 shards done, processed=34k total, dedup skipped=1. no 429s so far.
julie: badge enabled for tenants A/B.
maria: last update — final shard finished, job-20260218-0009 completed, processed=128214, dedup skipped=112, reconciliation shows aggregates back to expected levels (diffs <0.05%). disabling priority-burst flag now.
jen: confirmed consumer 429s stayed <1%. great.
ops-bot: incident-logger: created postmortem draft -> /incidents/2026-02-18-orphaned-telemetry-draft.md
maria: thanks team. we'll keep the console flag in staging for 24h and then remove if no regressions. good job.
